newsitem.title: UK: Tradepoint says Feb turnover exceeds Jan.
newsitem.headline: Tradepoint says Feb turnover exceeds Jan.

text.p: The Tradepoint Investment Exchange said on Tuesday it has achieved trading turnover of more than 80 million stg so far in February.
In January turnover was 73.25 million stg and the average trade size was 304,000 stg, compared with 350,000 stg in February.

Tradepoint is the main rival to Britain's London Stock Exchange. It offers investors a facility to buy and sell shares electronically in over 900 British companies, posted a loss of 2.82 million stg in the six months ended September 30, 1996.
Tradepoint's own shares are traded on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) as well as the Vancouver Stock Exchange.
